# Claude Code

```bash
claude mcp add --transport http --scope user gupshup https://mcp.gupshup.ai/enterprise-auth/mcp
```
Then run `/mcp` inside Claude Code, select **gupshup** and choose **Authenticate**. When prompted, sign in with your **Gupshup Enterprise account ID and password** for each channel (WhatsApp, SMS, RCS) you want to use, then choose which apps (Analytics, Templates, Campaigns) to allow.

**Already added Gupshup in claude.ai?** With the same account signed in to Claude Code, it's already available: run `/mcp` to check.

**Share with your team:** commit this as `.mcp.json` at your project root. Claude Code asks each teammate to approve it once:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "gupshup": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://mcp.gupshup.ai/enterprise-auth/mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

**Or install the plugin** (same server, plus updates through the marketplace):
```
/plugin marketplace add GupshupSuperAgent/mcp
/plugin install gupshup-mcp@gupshup
```

No Gupshup Enterprise account yet? Email [sales@gupshup.ai](mailto:sales@gupshup.ai).

Something not working? See [Troubleshooting](../troubleshooting.md).
